读取 materials.basis 全部材料及其原始回答、暂定判断和未定项，仅实现 includedElementIds 指定范围。完成全部代码和必要测试用例后才集中运行检查；平台随后还会独立执行已登记 profile。不得执行 Git、提交、推送、修改平台材料或自行批准。每个需求必须有准确的文件、符号和测试追溯；testRef 使用相对路径或 path#测试名，symbol 必须是文件中可定位的实际文本。无法实现的部分如实写 limitations。agent-result 只输出业务 JSON。
有限状态/决策表验收可在 execution.modelCheck 指定 modelId、programRef(repo: 相对可执行文件)、inputs、depth/paths/timeoutMs。实现者须编写真实适配器调用业务代码，读取 stdin JSON：{schemaVersion:1,modelId,kind:'state'|'decision-table',input,actions:[{event,actionRef,assertionRefs}]?,assertionRefs?}。stdout 只输出 JSON {states?:[实际初始与各步状态],assertions:{断言ID:真实布尔值},outputs?:[实际决策结果]}。不得回显期望值代替真实调用。平台按冻结模型枚举有限路径和输入并比对实际输出；缺少事件/断言绑定或达到边界必须记不完整。profile 仍须执行真实单元/集成测试。
Business output JSON schema:
{"type":"object","properties":{"summary":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":5000},"result":{"type":"object","properties":{"traceProposals":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"elementId":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":200},"obligationId":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":200},{"type":"null"}]},"path":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":1000},"symbol":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string","maxLength":2000},{"type":"null"}]},"testRef":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string","maxLength":2000},{"type":"null"}]},"reason":{"type":"string","maxLength":5000}},"required":["elementId","obligationId","path","symbol","testRef","reason"],"additionalProperties":false}},"testRefs":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1}},"limitations":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"deliveryContent":{"type":"object","properties":{"commitMessage":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"title":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"description":{"type":"string"}},"required":["commitMessage","title","description"],"additionalProperties":false}},"required":["traceProposals","testRefs","limitations","deliveryContent"],"additionalProperties":false}},"required":["summary","result"],"additionalProperties":false,"$schema":"http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"}
